name: I5. Member utilization versus premium
rawText:
# Do you know which insurance members generate the highest medical costs compared with the premiums they contribute?
#  - Which members have the highest medical loss ratios?
#  - How much premium revenue has been collected from each member?
#  - How much have insurance companies paid out for each member's claims?
#  - Which members have the highest total allowed claim amounts?
#  - Which members have submitted the most insurance claims?
#  - Are members with high premium contributions also generating high claim costs?
#  - Which members receive significantly more in insurer payments than they contribute in premiums?
#  - Which members have high medical loss ratios despite having relatively few claims?
#  - How does insurer-paid claim cost compare with premium collections across members?
#  - Which members should we review to better understand medical costs and insurance utilization?
# __________________________________________________

Clients: Id MemberId,
    Concat(FirstName, < >, LastName) Member,
    Policies.Sum(PremiumPayments.SumIf(Amount, Status = <Paid>)).Round(2) PremiumsCollected,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.Sum(AllowedAmount)).Round(2) AllowedAmount,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.Sum(PaidAmount)).Round(2) InsurerPaid,
    Policies.Sum(Claims.Count(Id)) ClaimCount,
    (100.0 * InsurerPaid / NullIf(PremiumsCollected, 0)).Round(2) MemberLossRatioPercent
  Where Policies.Count(Id) > 0
  Order MemberLossRatioPercent DESC, ClaimCount DESC
  Take 10
